format.keys: Relative file paths from the data/ directory (e.g. 'images/photo1.jpg')

values.uuid: String - UUID version 4 format (xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx where y is 8, 9, a, or b)
values.sha256: String - lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the file content

_metadata.file_count: Integer - total number of file entries (excluding _metadata itself)
_metadata.generated_at: String - ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) of when the registry was generated

exclusions: Hidden files and directories (any path component starting with '.')
Files matching glob patterns listed in config/ignore_patterns.txt
Symlinks whose resolved target path is already registered under its canonical relative path
Content-duplicate files: when multiple files have identical SHA-256 content hash, only the alphabetically-first relative path is registered; all others are excluded
rules.uuid_preservation: If an existing registry entry has a valid UUID v4 and the file's current sha256 matches the stored sha256, the existing UUID must be preserved unchanged
rules.uuid_generation: New or changed entries must receive a freshly generated random UUID version 4
rules.sorting: All keys in the output JSON must be sorted in ascending alphabetical order
rules.path_format: Paths are relative to the data/ directory using forward slashes as separators
